assessment: Word passed once in 42.2 seconds and 10 turns. Its application-result dialogs were recorded without harness answers. Excel's model reported saved edits and D4 = 15 and exited 0, but the task failed when its retained helper's AXFocusedWindow read returned -25204 and closure remained unconfirmed. changes.cleanupRead: Only -25204 retries in native read operations during cleanup, within one shared fifteen-second budget beginning at the first failure. The setup deadline is separate. Required reads fail immediately on other AX errors. Optional absent values retain their prior meaning. Actions are outside the retry loop.
changes.diagnostics: cleanupRetries, cleanupTotalWaitMs and cleanupReadWait retain setupCase, elapsed time, last AX code and attribute, and ready/deadline/error outcome, without overwriting setup diagnostics.
changes.parentWatchdog: Thirty seconds instead of fifteen, allowing the helper to finish the fifteen-second read wait and report closure or failure. Permission cancellation still aborts the helper. Existing retained-reference/focus/identity and app ownership checks remain.
changes.observationRead: Ready-state dialog observations have separate fifteen-second retry episodes. Only a complete observation resets its episode. A close received during a read or wait carries the spent episode into cleanup, including success-path and observation-end transitions.
changes.identityValidation: A read-wait epoch makes cleanup repeat complete retained-window, document and focus validation before pressing. Native close and discard button lookups validate retained document identity after their own reads.
